cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 2 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

dorms.name: Standard 10 Bed Mixed Dorm Ensuite
dorms.description: Dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer mixed accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription:
10 Bed Share + 2 Ensuite is very roomy, light and airy.  Amazing shower facilities at a 1:5 ratio in a big dorm.  You won't believe the size of the room! Perfect space to meet lots of friends and great for group bookings.

A/C and equipped with USB port

Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

privates.name: Superior Double Bed Private Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Private Queen + Ensuite & Courtyard is the perfect cheeky Noosa escape. Your own private space set amongst the tropical garden courtyard but enjoy the vibe of the hostel.  Perfect for a minimum 1 night stay close to everything in Noosa.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 30th Oct 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 30th Oct 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
